onboarding.welcome.title: Your band. Your data. No subscription.
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: Sleep, readiness and load are worked out on your phone. Nothing leaves it unless you say so.
onboarding.welcome.demo: Skip and use the demo band
onboarding.profile.title: What should we call you?
onboarding.profile.subtitle: Only used to greet you, and stored only on this device. You can leave it empty.
onboarding.profile.accountBody: Only for encrypted backup between your devices. Not built yet: for now everything stays on this phone.
onboarding.profile.promiseLocal: No account needed. Everything stays on this phone.
onboarding.profile.promiseTracking: No telemetry, no ads, no tracking.
onboarding.profile.promiseExport: Export all your data at any time. Uninstalling the app deletes it.
onboarding.body.title: A few body basics
onboarding.body.subtitle: Used for calories, heart-rate zones and Body age. All optional, and you can change them later.
onboarding.body.birthHint: Day, month, year. The year alone is enough; with the full date your age is exact to the day.
onboarding.body.sexNote: Sex at birth only tunes physiological reference values, such as VO₂ max norms and the calorie estimate.
onboarding.body.invalid: Check your input: height {heightMin} to {heightMax} {heightUnit}, weight {weightMin} to {weightMax} {weightUnit}, a real birth date that is not in the future, maximum heart rate 120 to 230.
onboarding.goals.title: What do you want to improve?
onboarding.goals.subtitle: Pick any. They are kept in your profile, and you can change them at any time.
onboarding.goals.controlBody: Goals never hide anything. Every metric stays available, and you can change your goals and your home screen at any time.
onboarding.permissions.title: Allow access
onboarding.permissions.subtitle: Only Bluetooth is required. Everything else is optional, and your phone asks only when you switch it on.
onboarding.permissions.bluetoothBody: Required to talk to your band. Your phone asks when you search for it.
onboarding.permissions.notificationsBloc: Notifications are blocked for OpenHoop in your phone settings.
onboarding.permissions.healthConnectBody: Writes measured values only, no scores
onboarding.permissions.healthConnectMiss: Health Connect did not give every permission. Allow them in Health Connect, or pick types under Integrations.
onboarding.permissions.locationBody: GPS routes for workouts you record
onboarding.permissions.locationBlocked: Location is blocked for OpenHoop in your phone settings.
onboarding.permissions.locationRevoke: Location access can only be taken back in your phone settings.
onboarding.official.title: One band, one app at a time
onboarding.official.subtitle: Your band keeps one Bluetooth bond at a time. To pair it here, it must be free of any other phone or app.
onboarding.official.onlyBody: Recommended. Simplest, and keeps all history in one place.
onboarding.official.switchBody: Re-pair each time you switch. A night the other app reads first is cleared from the band, so OpenHoop misses it.
onboarding.official.guideOnlyBody: If the band is paired with another phone or app, forget it in that phone's Bluetooth settings first.
onboarding.official.guideSwitchBody: You can pair the band with the official app again at any time. Unpair it from OpenHoop first, then pair it there.
onboarding.official.firmwareBody: A firmware update can change the data format. Read your band here first. OpenHoop itself never updates or changes the firmware, and records the version your band reports.
onboarding.official.firmwareNote: Reading the band was checked on firmware 50.43.2.0 (MG). Setup records the version your band reports.
onboarding.official.firmwareNoteKnown: Reading the band was checked on firmware 50.43.2.0 (MG). Your band last reported {version}.
onboarding.official.importTitle: Bringing history from the official app?
onboarding.official.importBody: Ask the official app for your data export, then import it under Settings, Import and export. It stays labelled as the official app's own numbers and never mixes with OpenHoop's scores.
onboarding.pair.title: Looking for your band
onboarding.pair.subtitle: Keep the charged band close to your phone and turn Bluetooth on.
onboarding.pair.switchNote: You chose to switch now and then: unpair the band from OpenHoop before you pair it with the other app.
onboarding.connected.title: Band connected
onboarding.connected.subtitle: We'll read its settings before changing anything.
onboarding.connected.readOnly: OpenHoop never updates firmware. It changes a band setting only when you do, and saves the original value first.
onboarding.setup.title: Setting up
onboarding.setup.subtitle: Keep your phone near the band. This takes a few minutes.
onboarding.setup.backupFailed: Not saved. You can read it later under Band configuration.
onboarding.setup.firmware: We never update firmware. Version {version} is recorded with your data.
onboarding.setup.savedNone: No readings were saved yet. Wear the band tonight and sync tomorrow morning. Your first scores need a full night.
onboarding.setup.discarded: {count} readings were from before the date you entered and were not kept.
onboarding.wear.title: How to wear it
onboarding.wear.subtitle: Good skin contact gives better heart-rate and HRV data. Pick where you'll wear it.
onboarding.wear.note: OpenHoop keeps this as a note with your band. Scores don't change with it yet.
onboarding.wear.tip1: One finger-width above the wrist bone.
onboarding.wear.tip2: Snug: it shouldn't slide when you move.
onboarding.wear.tip4: Keep the sensor clean and dry.
onboarding.wear.tip5: Wear it while you sleep for the best results.
onboarding.calibration.title: Wear it for {count} nights
onboarding.calibration.subtitle: We learn your normal before we judge anything. Until then, scores are an indication.
onboarding.calibration.night1: First readings: sleep, HRV, heart rate and load, shown as an indication.
onboarding.calibration.night3: A first normal range for HRV and resting heart rate takes shape.
onboarding.calibration.night4: Ranges and readiness are based on your own baseline.
